name: TimeTable Management System
desc: A comprehensive web-based application built using JSP, Servlets, Apache Tomcat, and MySQL that simplifies the management of academic schedules with real-time attendance tracking. The system supports three roles: Admin, Faculty, and Students, each with specific functionalities. It prevents scheduling conflicts and ensures concurrency-free operations across all user interactions.
features: Multi-role system supporting Admin, Faculty, and Students
Conflict-free timetable generation preventing scheduling overlaps
User management with role-based access control
Today's schedule view for quick access to current classes

challenges.title: Preventing Scheduling Conflicts
challenges.solution: Implemented validation algorithms to ensure no two lectures can be scheduled in the same period or classroom, maintaining data integrity across the system.

challenges.title: Real-time Attendance System
challenges.solution: Developed a concurrent-safe attendance marking mechanism that prevents duplicate entries while allowing faculty to mark attendance during ongoing classes.

challenges.title: Role-based Access Control
challenges.solution: Created a secure authentication system with differentiated access levels for admins, faculty, and students, ensuring each user can only access appropriate functionalities.

name: Shree Deep Rekha Traders Website
desc: Shree Deep Rekha Traders is a professional business website designed to showcase a diverse range of plastic household products. This is a complete rebuild of the older HTML/CSS/JS site into a modern, SEO-optimized, mobile-friendly, and production-ready web application using Next.js and TypeScript. The website features a responsive design, clean UI components, smooth animations, and blazing-fast performance through Vercel hosting.
features: SEO-optimized layout with proper meta tags
Auto Image Slider for featured products

challenges.title: Optimizing Page Load Speed
challenges.solution: Implemented lazy loading for images and modern Next.js optimizations to improve performance, resulting in blazing-fast page loads even on slower connections.

challenges.title: Mobile Responsiveness
challenges.solution: Created a fully responsive layout using CSS Modules to ensure optimal viewing experience across all devices from mobile phones to large desktop screens.

name: Secure Login System
desc: Secure Login System is a robust authentication and verification system designed to enhance security for web applications. It features user login with mandatory email verification, session management, and secure data handling, all built using Java Servlets, JSP, and MySQL on an Apache Tomcat Server. The system follows the MVC architecture and centralizes all tasks within a single servlet for streamlined operation.
features: Protection against SQL injection and XSS attacks

challenges.title: Implementing Secure Authentication
challenges.solution: Created a multi-layered authentication process with email verification and secure password storage using industry-standard encryption techniques.

challenges.title: Session Management
challenges.solution: Developed a robust session handling mechanism that prevents session hijacking while providing a seamless user experience with appropriate timeout mechanisms.
